name: Al Majeed
description: His glory encompasses nobility, excellence in deeds and generosity. Al Majeed and Al Maajid share this meaning, with a difference of emphasis.
summary: Al Majeed expresses glory, nobility and generosity. Quran 11:73 pairs the name with Al Hameed, the Praiseworthy. Al Maajid is a related Arabic form with an overlapping meaning, not a different spelling of this word.
